full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting shows two men in a tense encounter before a weathered brick wall and a barred dark opening. At left, a seated man in a vivid lemon yellow fedora leans forward, his face mostly hidden under the low brim. He wears a pale yellow long sleeved shirt beneath a black vest. One hand rests heavily on his bent knee; the other rises near his mouth as though he is thinking or holding a small object. At right and closer to the viewer, a second man in a dark navy suit is seen from behind, his broad back obscuring much of the yellow hatted figure. His short dark hair and the curve of his neck catch a faint cool highlight. The gap between their bodies centers the yellow hat and the first man's partly concealed expression. Behind them, black vertical bars break the top left of the composition, and irregular salmon, rust, and gray brickwork emerges on either side. The lower edge glows with rusty red and orange paint that rises into the dark clothing. Brushwork is thick and rough, with scraped marks in the wall and broad black planes across the coat. Light from the upper left makes the hat almost fluorescent and touches the shirt sleeves, while the suited man stays largely in shadow. The scene feels private, wary, and theatrical, organized by a sharp color accent inside a close, crowded composition.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画描绘两名男子在风化砖墙和带栏杆的深色开口前紧张相对。左侧，一位戴鲜亮柠檬黄礼帽的男子坐着前倾，低压帽檐几乎遮住整张脸。他在浅黄色长袖衬衫外穿黑背心。一只手沉沉落在弯曲膝盖上，另一只手抬到嘴边，像在思考或捏着小东西。右侧离观者更近，第二名男子穿深海军蓝西装，以背影出现，宽阔后背遮住大半戴黄帽的人。短黑发和颈部曲线接住微弱冷色高光。两人身体之间的缝隙把黄帽和第一位男子半隐的神情置于中央。身后，黑色竖栏切开左上构图，两侧显出不规则鲑红、锈色和灰色砖面。下缘由锈红橙色颜料发亮，并向深色衣物上攀升。笔触厚而粗糙，墙上有刮擦痕迹，外套由宽黑色平面概括。左上方的光让帽子近乎荧亮，也碰到衬衫袖子；穿西装的男子大部分留在阴影里。场景私密、警觉且带戏剧感，由拥挤近景中的锐利色彩重音组织。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting uses heavy dark masses, distressed surface texture, and one electric warm accent to create visual tension. Broad black and navy planes overlap in the foreground, interrupting a rough field of salmon, rust, umber, and gray. Thick brushwork alternates with scraped patches and dry scumbling, so the surface feels worn and active. A single saturated yellow shape near the upper middle becomes a strong focal point against surrounding shadow. Hard vertical marks give the composition a compressed graphic rhythm, while more irregular strokes disturb the edges. Directional light from above one side catches the bright accent and a few pale raised areas; the largest masses stay in deep shadow. Figures or forms are constructed from decisive silhouettes more than fine outlines, and small facial or surface details are allowed to disappear. The whole image feels urgent, theatrical, and gritty, with concentrated color doing much of the emotional work.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性油画用沉重深色体块、磨损表面肌理与一处带电感的暖色重音制造视觉紧张。宽阔黑色和海军蓝平面在前景重叠，打断鲑红、锈色、棕褐与灰色的粗糙色域。厚笔触与刮擦色块、干擦薄层交替，使表面陈旧而活跃。上方中央附近唯一饱和黄色形状在周围阴影前成为强焦点。坚硬竖线赋予构图压缩的图形节奏，更不规则的笔痕则扰动边缘。从上方一侧来的定向光照到明亮重音和少数浅色凸面；最大体块仍处深影。形体主要由果断剪影而非精细轮廓搭建，小小的面部或表面细节允许消失。整体急促、戏剧性而粗粝，集中颜色承担了大量情绪表达。
theme_en: Two men in tense conversation against a worn brick wall
theme_zh: 两名男子在旧砖墙前紧张交谈
name: Harry Weisburd
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
